item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-92beee77d23d769e","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Two survey experiments found that direct questions produced CCP approval above 90 percent, whereas anonymous list experiments produced support of roughly 50–70 percent; the experiments also suggested that fear of government repression discouraged about 40 percent of citizens from participating in anti-regime protests.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.9","7B.1"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published in 2024 and therefore outside 2023, but directly evaluates political opinion and repression in contemporary China relevant to the 2023 environment.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern the CCP and Chinese government during Xi Jinping’s rule; the supplied text does not isolate a personal Xi directive.","limitations":["The supplied abstract does not provide fieldwork dates or separate Xi-specific causal attribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-92beee77d23d769e","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"A study of rural social-service organizations found that party-state incentives increasingly incorporated and controlled social workers; tracing a decade-long Guangdong project, it concluded that incorporation could undermine NGOs’ future autonomy in rural development.","question_ids":["4B.3","6B.4","6B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The article was published in 2023 and describes an ongoing institutional trend, but the supplied abstract does not isolate events occurring only in calendar year 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns party-state governance under Xi-era rural modernization campaigns; personal Xi attribution is not established.","limitations":["No quantitative service-outcome measure is supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-92beee77d23d769e","start_unit":10,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"By 2021, China had more than 1,800 government guidance funds with estimated target capital of US$1.52 trillion, but only 26 percent had met their target capital size; realized capital fell particularly short in non-coastal regions because of weak private partners and ventures, leadership turnover, and evaluation difficulties.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.7","5B.8","8B.6","8B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2023 using evidence through 2021; it is relevant background for policies continuing into 2023 but is not a 2023-only result.","ruler_attribution":"The program is a Chinese central/local government instrument; the supplied text does not establish a personal Xi decision.","limitations":["The abstract does not identify Xi-era execution decisions or 2023 outcomes separately."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5ccb4f0ae363729a","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Research on the Belt and Road Initiative in Ethiopia found that Chinese investment became more important after the BRI and that China informally promised to encourage flows to BRI states even when capital flows elsewhere were restricted; Ethiopian actors used the initiative for their own development agenda, while local criticisms challenged wholly positive interpretations.","question_ids":["2B.5","5B.1","5B.4","5B.8","8B.3","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2023 and based on field and documentary research covering the BRI period; the supplied text does not isolate calendar-year 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The BRI is a Chinese state strategy associated with Xi Jinping, but the abstract does not attribute a specific Ethiopian outcome personally to Xi.","limitations":["The abstract does not quantify harms or establish direct Xi control over individual projects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5ccb4f0ae363729a","start_unit":10,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"An empirical study of Zhejiang’s corporate social credit scores found that politically connected firms received higher scores, driven by a social-responsibility category rewarding government awards and contributions to causes sanctioned by the CCP.","question_ids":["4B.9","5B.4","5B.5","7B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published in 2023 using Zhejiang data; the supplied text does not specify the observation year, so direct 2023 fit is uncertain.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns a Chinese party-state system under Xi-era governance; personal Xi attribution is not demonstrated.","limitations":["Only Zhejiang’s published local scores were analyzed."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5ccb4f0ae363729a","start_unit":11,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"A study of aviation, finance, and food-safety governance concluded that China’s policy-experimentation regimes were experiencing maladaptation: consolidated regimes could not generate alternatives in aviation, moderately consolidated regimes had selection problems in finance, and unconsolidated regimes impeded niche creation in food safety.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.7","8B.6","8B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published in 2023 and addresses present governance challenges, but the supplied abstract does not date each finding specifically to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern Chinese governance under Xi-era institutional conditions; no personal Xi decision is identified.","limitations":["The abstract provides sectoral conclusions but no numerical outcome estimates."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5ccb4f0ae363729a","start_unit":12,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"Research characterized Beijing’s Taiwan strategy as hybrid influencing combining military threats, covert infiltration, attraction of Taiwanese public opinion, and lawfare designed to frame Taiwan as an internal dispute, restrict its international space, and contain self-determination while seeking to win without fighting.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.5","2B.8","8B.1","8B.3","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published in 2023 and describes an ongoing strategy, but the abstract does not limit the evidence to calendar year 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The strategy is attributed to Beijing and is relevant to Xi-era policy; the supplied text does not identify a specific personal order by Xi.","limitations":["The abstract does not quantify coercive incidents or distinguish Xi decisions from broader party-state policy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5ccb4f0ae363729a","start_unit":12,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"A dataset covering party secretaries in all 287 prefecture-level cities from 2013–2020 found that after local leaders were prosecuted for corruption, provincial chiefs tended to appoint outsiders lacking local experience and connections, using non-local appointments to increase hierarchical control and oversight.","question_ids":["5B.5","7B.5","8B.4","8B.5"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2023 using evidence through 2020; it provides Xi-era institutional context but no calendar-year 2023 observation.","ruler_attribution":"The pattern is linked to Xi Jinping’s anti-corruption campaign, though the mechanism operates through provincial appointment decisions.","limitations":["The abstract does not establish whether outsider appointments improved corruption or service outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5ccb4f0ae363729a","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"A study of rural social organizations found that organizations initially had substantial autonomy in setting agendas and designing services, but increasing party-state incentives to use and co-opt social work produced incorporation and stronger state control; the traced Guangdong project eventually terminated.","question_ids":["4B.3","6B.4","6B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published in 2023 and describes a decade-long process; the supplied abstract does not establish that the termination occurred in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns party-state policy under Xi-era rural modernization; no personal Xi directive is identified.","limitations":["The abstract does not provide comparable service-quality measurements before and after incorporation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5ccb4f0ae363729a","start_unit":16,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"Research on court-centralization reforms found that local courts remained structurally dependent on same-level party-state institutions, and that party-state reliance on horizontal power concentration and hierarchy undermined both judicial autonomy and the intended centralization reforms.","question_ids":["4B.4","7B.6","7B.7","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published in 2023 and evaluates recent reforms, but the supplied abstract does not specify a 2023-only observation period.","ruler_attribution":"The institutional failure is attributed to the CCP’s one-party governing structure under Xi-era reforms, not to a specific personal Xi act.","limitations":["Evidence comes from interviews in four localities."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5ccb4f0ae363729a","start_unit":20,"end_unit":20,"fact_summary":"Analysis of China’s plea-leniency system found that procuratorates had overshadowed police and further marginalized courts; defendants had little chance of acquittal and legal defense was weak, with efficiency and crime control taking precedence over rights protections.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","4B.4"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published in 2023, but the supplied abstract describes a broader criminal-process development rather than a specifically dated 2023 event.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns China’s criminal justice system under Xi-era governance; no personal Xi decision is identified.","limitations":["The abstract does not provide case counts or a direct 2023 outcome measure."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8881c0efd636aa6b","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"A 2023 thesis found that Xi-era speeches and policy documents promoted sweeping legislation to reinforce the CCP’s monopoly over information and mass-data control, and that official cyberpolitical narratives combined performance-based and ideological claims to justify party rule and Xi’s central leadership.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.6","4B.9","7B.1","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The thesis was accepted in 2023, while its research corpus covers the Xi era rather than only 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The analysis explicitly centers Xi Jinping and the CCP leadership.","limitations":["This is a narrative analysis of speeches and policy documents, not an independent audit of implementation outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-657725751964eff8","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that in 2022 repeated Covid lockdowns affected hundreds of millions; some authorities used barriers and residents reported difficulty accessing food and medical care, privacy violations, censorship, livelihood disruption, and police or health-official brutality.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.9","4B.9","6B.2","6B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report covers events of 2022, outside the requested 2023–2023 period, but is relevant inherited context.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the measures to Chinese authorities under Xi’s government; personal Xi implementation is not separately established.","limitations":["Evidence is presented as reported incidents and does not provide a complete national causal assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-657725751964eff8","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that at least 231 people had been arrested under Hong Kong’s National Security Law or sedition provisions, 138 had been charged, and most charged individuals had spent nearly a year or longer in pretrial detention; the law presumed against bail.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","4B.3","4B.4","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report covers 2022, outside the requested period, but documents the inherited institutional context entering 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The measures were imposed by Hong Kong authorities under Beijing’s direction; the supplied text does not establish a personal Xi order.","limitations":["The figures are reported by Human Rights Watch and concern Hong Kong rather than mainland China."]},{"source_id":"SRC-657725751964eff8","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that as many as one million people had been wrongfully detained in Xinjiang at the height of the Strike Hard Campaign and that Chinese authorities had sentenced an estimated half-million people, many of whom remained imprisoned.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.7","4B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report covers conditions through 2022, outside the requested period, but describes continuing inherited exposure entering 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report links the policies to China’s top leadership and Xi-era Xinjiang governance, but does not identify a 2023 personal decision.","limitations":["The figures are estimates and the supplied text does not provide a 2023 update."]},{"source_id":"SRC-657725751964eff8","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that Covid controls impeded access to health care, food, and necessities; unknown numbers died after being denied non-Covid medical treatment, while authorities censored criticism and detained netizens who complained.","question_ids":["3B.9","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","6B.2","6B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report covers 2022, outside the requested period, but records policy failures inherited into 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The measures were implemented by Chinese authorities under Xi’s government; personal responsibility for individual failures is not separately documented.","limitations":["The number of non-Covid deaths is explicitly unknown."]},{"source_id":"SRC-657725751964eff8","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"China’s Cyberspace Administration announced that it had dealt with 1.34 billion social-media accounts, removed 22 million illegal messages, and closed 3,200 websites.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.9","7B.1","7B.2"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report identifies the announcement as occurring in 2022, outside the requested period.","ruler_attribution":"The action was by a central state regulator within Xi-era digital governance; no personal Xi order is supplied.","limitations":["The announcement’s categories and verification methodology are not provided."]},{"source_id":"SRC-657725751964eff8","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that China had no laws protecting against discrimination based on sexual orientation or gender identity and that same-sex partnerships were not recognized; authorities also banned or edited depictions of same-sex relationships in media.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.7","6B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report covers 2022, outside the requested period, but describes the legal context entering 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The legal and censorship framework is attributed to Chinese authorities under Xi-era rule; no personal Xi decision is identified.","limitations":["The supplied text does not report any 2023 legal change."]},{"source_id":"SRC-657725751964eff8","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"The Climate Action Tracker rated China’s domestic climate target as highly insufficient for limiting warming to 1.5°C, while China remained the largest greenhouse-gas emitter and continued substantial coal use despite leading global renewable-energy production.","question_ids":["1B.10","5B.1","5B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The report covers conditions through 2022, outside the requested period, but evaluates targets and trends relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The targets and energy policies are Chinese government policies under Xi-era leadership; personal Xi implementation is not separately established.","limitations":["The supplied text gives no 2023 emissions or implementation figures."]},{"source_id":"SRC-657725751964eff8","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that China had adopted a 2019 restriction on illegal timber imports but had yet to enforce it, despite a November commitment with the United States to eliminate global illegal deforestation through enforcement of respective laws.","question_ids":["2B.7","5B.7","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The report covers 2022, outside the requested period, but documents an implementation gap entering 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The commitment and domestic enforcement responsibility belong to the Chinese government under Xi-era leadership; no personal Xi decision is identified.","limitations":["The supplied text does not quantify illegal timber imports or subsequent enforcement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-657725751964eff8","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"China did not condemn Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and its violations of the laws of war, while continuing to provide direct assistance and military aid to abusive governments including the Taliban in Afghanistan and Myanmar’s military junta.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.6","2B.2","2B.5","2B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report covers 2022, outside the requested period, but describes foreign-policy positions and assistance relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes these positions and assistance to the Chinese government under Xi Jinping; it does not identify separate personal decisions for each case.","limitations":["The supplied text does not specify the amount or type of military aid."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6e83052bd8085151","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Analysis of World Values Survey waves from 2007, 2012, and 2018 found that increased trust in government coincided with decreased local-election participation, while views of corruption and perceived efficacy through peaceful demonstrations were more relevant to regime legitimacy; legitimacy was more precarious among poorer and younger citizens.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.7","4B.8","7B.1"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2023 but based on survey waves ending in 2018; it provides background rather than a direct 2023 observation.","ruler_attribution":"The findings span Hu and the first five years of Xi’s rule and do not isolate personal Xi causation.","limitations":["The supplied abstract reports associations, not causal effects."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-7e422c2c31f823f7","SRC-a32da7c3aac871c9","SRC-df96f98a8494a0df","SRC-9a695b1374e755f3","SRC-3d1a86991448688f","SRC-c1ae2a68e9d426e4","SRC-f4762be87592bd12"],"batch_limitations":["Most supplied documents are bibliographic records, abstracts, or reports covering periods before 2023;
